Baseline fails all three: ED 400.75 < 500.94 (mass-limited, closable via thin foils + thickness), 4C plates (anode_potential_v min -0.19 V) and overheats (T_max 354.29 K > 333.15, dominated by 1C discharge segment at h=10) -> architecture + formulation + thermal fallback at Stage 3. Note: 4C capacity_ah key under-reports charge acceptance (t x C_rate/3600 instead of t x current; physically 158.7 s x 20 A = 0.882 Ah accepted before 4.2 V cutoff) - recorded honestly, does not affect stage3 judgment.｜未检查 criteria: max_energy_ev, max_homo_ev

Propose · 候选方案
候选部件类型说明内容
OKane2022 system电芯体系体系system candidate: NMC811/Gr-SiOx with cracking model; same electrochemical+mass basis as Chen2020 (verified by parameter-set dump: geometry/density/stoich identical) but carries native lithium-plating parameters instead of injected defaults; used as plating-judgment cross-checkOKane2022

Chen2020 lacks native plating parameters (runner injects standard defaults). OKane2022 is a parameter-set superset on the identical mass basis with native plating physics - cross-checking the 4C plating judgment between the two removes the injected-default uncertainty. Not an ED lever (identical mass basis). Dual-judgment rule: final design must pass 4C under both parameter sets.

SHEET 06 · FINAL / 最终推荐

最终推荐

Winning design R7B (bridge/r7b_negR261.json), validated under BOTH Chen2020 and OKane2022 (dual judgment): NMC811/graphite(-SiOx) pouch cell, Al foil 8 um / Cu foil 6 um, positive electrode 75.6 um, negative electrode 105.8 um (N/P 1.40), both particle radii 2.61 um, electrolyte sigma 2.0 S/m / D_e 4.5e-10 m2/s / t+ 0.45 (formulation overrides, aggressive upper-bound estimates), negative porosity 0.45, separator 8 um / porosity 0.55, total heat transfer coefficient h = 60 W/m2/K (immersion-class liquid cooling). Measured (DFN, tool outputs): Chen2020 -> ED 642.098 Wh/kg >= 500.94, T_max 326.829 K <= 333.15 K, anode surface potential min +0.01826 V (no plating); OKane2022 -> ED 641.118 Wh/kg, T_max 328.189 K, anode min +0.01798 V (no plating). 4C protocol = 1C discharge to v_min then 20 A CC charge to v_max at 45 C ambient, per contract. Honest caveats: (1) charge-capacity key in 4C outputs is under-reported 5x by a pybamm_runner library bug (t*C_rate/3600 missing the 5 Ah nominal factor); it does not affect the stage3 judgments (plated/T_max), physical charge acceptance ~4.7-5.0 Ah computed separately; (2) electrolyte transport overrides are literature-upper-bound estimates (estimate-flagged in proposals), not measured formulations; (3) real_compute=false -> no first-principles endorsement (see endorse entry).
结论 achieved
